title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00011 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
05:45 - 06:00: Performed prejob meeting to skid cantilever
06:00 - 06:30: Skidded cantilever onto f-11 slot, 3m to starboard
06:30 - 07:00: Performed after skid jobs and cleared in moon pool area
07:00 - 12:00: Removed production flow line from f11b. Meanwhile l/d HPDR to cantilever, r/d diverter chains and installed elevators, spotted WL equipment on rig floor, prepared for r/u manifolds and hoses to XT
12:00 - 13:00: Continued with preparations and r/u WL to r/u and check chicksan manifolds) Meanwhile pressure tested blind flange on production wing valve
13:00 - 15:00: Removed the fox hole and started to lower the wire line BOP into moon pool, continued with r/u chicksan manifolds on x-mas tree.
15:00 - 18:00: R/u top hatches in the moon pool. Meanwhile continued with lowering the WL BOP and positioning in moon pool. Lowered hoses down to WL BOP
18:00 - 18:15: Performed pre-job meeting to remove XT cap and install lower riser and WL BOP
18:15 - 19:30: Removed XT cap and installed lower riser
19:30 - 19:45: Performed pre-job meeting to install WL BOP
19:45 - 21:30: Lifted and installed WL BOP, installed hoses
21:30 - 23:00: Pressure tested bleed off manifold. 20/345bar 5/10 min. Meanwhile p/u WL riser, performed housekeeping on rig floor, performed maintenance on gas trap in shaker
23:00 - 00:00: Attempted to pressure test lower riser and WL BOP. Observed leak in the connection between lower riser and XT. Drained riser and lifted lower riser and WL BOP from XT. Secured work place. Inspected connection. Observed scratches on the internal sealing face on the XT side
